newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodia opens direct phone link with N.America.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia opens direct phone link with N.America.

text.p: Cambodia started direct telecommunications links to Canada and the United States Friday with the commissioning of a new earth station.
The F3 Satellite Earth Station was installed by Australia's Telstra Corp. under a business cooperation contract with Cambodia's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications.
The new station provides Cambodia with access to Pacific Ocean satellites. It supplies direct links to the United States and Canada, while links to other Pacific nations can be opened when required.

"I hope the improvement in the telecommunications quality to the USA and Canada from today and the reduced tariff rates from Feb. 1 will enhance all relationships, including business, between our two countries," said MPTC Secretary of State So Khun.
